JournalEntry.title: JournalEntry
JournalEntry.description: A daily notebook journal entry written in English/Arabic and translated into vocalized Fusha Arabic with interactive interlinear tokens.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated user who owns this journal entry.

originalText.description: The user's original journal entry text.

fullArabicTranslation.description: The full vocalized Fusha (Modern Standard / Quranic) Arabic translation.

tokens.description: Bounded list of tokenized Fusha Arabic words with meanings, roots, and context sentences (max 80 tokens).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the entry was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the entry was last updated.

WordBankItem.title: WordBankItem
WordBankItem.description: A vocalized Fusha Arabic word in the user's Word Bank tracking usageCount and reviewCount toward the 20/20 Mastery Rule.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated user who owns this vocabulary word.

arabicWord.description: Vocalized Fusha Arabic word with Harakat.

normalizedWord.description: Unvocalized base Arabic lemma used to match occurrences across journal entries.

englishMeaning.description: Concise English meaning of the word.

root.description: Spaced 3-letter Arabic triliteral root (e.g., س ج د).

partOfSpeech.description: Grammatical part of speech (e.g., noun, verb, particle, adjective).

contextSentenceArabic.description: Vocalized Fusha context sentence from the user's journal entry.

contextSentenceEnglish.description: English translation of the context sentence.

visualKeyword.description: Visual cue prompt keywords for contextual flashcards.

usageCount.description: Number of times this word has been used across journal entries (20 required for mastery).

reviewCount.description: Number of times this word has been reviewed in the contextual flashcard engine (20 required for mastery).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the word was first added.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the word was last updated.

UserStats.title: UserStats
UserStats.description: Tracks user journaling streaks, volume, reviews, and 20/20 mastery progress.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated user.

totalWordsEncountered.description: Total unique Fusha words in the Word Bank.

masteredWordsCount.description: Total words that have reached 20/20 mastery.

lastJournalDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD date string of the most recent journal entry.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when stats were last updated.

/journalEntries/{entryId}.description: Stores user journal entries with vocalized Fusha translations and interlinear tokens.

/wordBank/{wordId}.description: Stores user Fusha vocabulary items and their 20/20 usageCount and reviewCount mastery progress.

/userStats/{userId}.description: Stores user streak, volume, and mastery progress statistics.
